title: Full Body Master
description: 3-round circuit mixing squats, push-ups, core and plyometrics for a complete and balanced workout

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower, rise halfway, lower again, then rise fully

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet lifted, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: No-push-up burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
